template.cantilever.title: Cantilever beam
template.cantilever.description: A square bar fixed at one end with a load at the tip. Finds deflection and stress and compares them automatically with beam theory.
template.cavity.title: Lid-driven cavity
template.cavity.description: Flow inside a square box whose lid slides. The classic CFD benchmark, compared with Ghia et al. reference data (Re = 100).
template.channel.title: Flow between parallel plates
template.channel.description: Laminar flow between two plates. Checks that the developed velocity profile becomes a parabola (Poiseuille flow).
err.symmetry_plane: Symmetry face {face} is not a flat plane normal to x, y or z. Only flat cut faces normal to a coordinate axis can be symmetry planes.
err.symmetry_rbm: Without a fixed face, symmetry planes are needed in all three directions (x, y and z), or the part can slide or spin. Add a fixed face or symmetry planes in the missing directions.
check.no_fixed: No face is fixed. The body floats freely, so it cannot be solved.
check.no_load: No load or pressure is applied. All results would be zero.
check.mesh_stale: The geometry or mesh size changed, so the mesh must be regenerated.
check.slender: Slenderness L/h = {ratio:.1f}. Below 10, the comparison with beam theory becomes inaccurate.
check.coarse: The mesh is coarse; deflection may come out a few percent low. Use 'normal' or finer for the final run.
check.re_range: Reynolds number Re = {re:.0f}. The comparison with Ghia's reference data is only valid at Re = 100.
check.re_turbulent: Reynolds number Re = {re:.0f} is beyond the laminar range. This prototype handles laminar flow only.
check.engine_missing: {engine} is not installed. Use the built-in preview solver or install the solver.
check.no_builtin: This template has no built-in preview solver. OpenFOAM must be installed.
check.entrance: The entrance length (about {le:.3f} m) is too long for the channel length.
verify.cantilever: Tip deflection (beam theory with shear correction)
verify.cavity: Mean error of centreline u (Ghia et al. 1982, Re = 100)
err.not_found: Case {case_id} not found. Call list_cases to see existing cases.
err.revision: The case was changed by another operation (current revision {current}). Read it with describe_case and call again with expected_revision={current}.
err.path: This field cannot be changed: {path}. See 'editable' in describe_case(detail="full").
err.role: Role '{role}' is not available for this analysis. Allowed roles: {roles}
err.blocked: The readiness check has blocking problems. Fix the items from validate_case first.
err.confirm: To delete, pass confirm equal to the case id '{case_id}'.
err.no_results: No results yet. Call run_simulation first.
err.memory: This mesh ({nodes} nodes) needs about {need} GB of memory, but only about {have} GB is available now. Close other apps and run again, or use a coarser mesh. In a mesh study the fine level uses the most memory.
err.memory_short: The computer ran out of memory during the solve. Close other apps and run again, or use a coarser mesh.
err.face_lost: The face(s) {faces} carrying a condition are missing from the mesh, so that condition would be ignored. The run was stopped. Re-import the shape or pick the faces again.
err.probe_unsupported: Point and face values are not available for this kind of result ({kind}). Use get_results and render_view instead.
err.faceted_step: This STEP is made of {faces} flat triangles (a mesh converted to STEP). Reading it would take minutes and give one face per triangle. Import the original STL instead (or export STL from Blender).
result.stress_singular: The peak stress keeps rising as the mesh is refined ({a:.0f} → {b:.0f} → {c:.0f} MPa). It may be a stress singularity from an idealised shape or support (a sharp corner, the edge of a fully fixed face), so this peak cannot be used to judge strength. Model the real fillet or support, or choose the region to assess and check that the stress there converges.
result.yplus: The wall cells have an average y+ of {yp:.0f}, outside the range where wall functions work (about 20-300). Turbulent pressure drop and wall friction may be off by several to tens of percent; check that a different mesh size gives the same answer.
result.not_refined: The three meshes have almost the same number of elements ({a} → {b} → {c}). Refinement did not really change the mesh, so the answer cannot be verified this way. The file's triangles may be too fine, or remeshing the surface may have failed.
result.peak_on_support: The peak stress {vm:.0f} MPa is at the edge of a fixed face. Fully rigid support edges tend to give a stress singularity, so this value cannot be used to judge strength. A little away from the supports the maximum is {away:.0f} MPa (a reference value, not a safety factor for the whole part). Check with a support closer to the real one (bolts, contact).
result.yield: Max von Mises stress {vm:.0f} MPa exceeds the typical yield strength {sy:.0f} MPa. The part would deform plastically, so this linear elastic result does not hold.
template.thermal-block.title: Heat conduction block
template.thermal-block.description: Heat flowing through a block whose two ends are held at fixed temperatures. Compared automatically with Fourier's law (Q = kAΔT/L).
verify.thermal-block: Heat flow through the block (Fourier's law)
check.no_temperature: No face sets the temperature (fixed temperature or convection), so the temperature level is undefined.
check.no_heat: There is no temperature difference or heat input, so the whole body will sit at one temperature.
err.no_solid: The file has no closed solid body. Surface-only data cannot be analysed; export it as a solid from your CAD tool.
err.cad_size: The file is too large (limit {mb} MB).
check.no_inlet: No inlet face. Nothing drives the flow, so it cannot be solved.
check.no_outlet: No outlet face. The fluid has nowhere to go, so it cannot be solved.
check.turbulent_model: Inlet Reynolds number Re = {re:.0f} is turbulent. The k-omega SST model will be used (less certain than laminar).
verify.none_reason: There is no analytic solution for this shape. Re-run with the fine mesh and check that the result does not change.
verify.pattern_reason: The boundary conditions differ from the reference (textbook) setup, so no comparison is possible.
template.sphere-drag.title: Flow past a sphere (drag)
template.sphere-drag.description: Finds the drag coefficient of a sphere in uniform flow and compares it with the Schiller-Naumann correlation (Re = 100). The standard external-flow benchmark.
template.plate-hole.title: Plate with a hole in tension
template.plate-hole.description: Pulls a plate with a central hole and compares the stress concentration at the hole edge with Heywood's formula.
template.fin.title: Cooling fin
template.fin.description: A pin fin heated at its base and cooled by the surrounding air. The heat leaving the base is compared with the analytic fin solution.
verify.fin: Heat through the fin base (fin theory)
job.waiting: Waiting for another job to finish
check.need_fluid_and_solid: At least one fluid body and one solid body are needed. Set the role of each body.
err.need_two_bodies: Conjugate heat transfer needs a file with two or more bodies, e.g. a cold plate and the water in its channel.
err.busy: This case is being saved by another action. Try again in a moment.
err.fixed_roles: This template is a fixed benchmark whose boundary pattern cannot change ({path}). To solve other conditions, import the geometry as a new case.
template.capacitor.title: Parallel-plate capacitor
template.capacitor.description: Finds potential and capacitance between plates; checked against C = εA/d.
template.coax.title: Coaxial cable
template.coax.description: Finds coaxial capacitance and electric field; compared with the cylindrical analytic solution.
template.busbar.title: Busbar Joule heating
template.busbar.description: Finds current and temperature rise in a copper bar; checked against resistance and conduction formulas.
template.import-electrostatic.title: Electrostatics
template.import-current.title: DC current and Joule heating
err.no_voltage: At least one fixed-potential face is required. Set a ground or a voltage.
err.tube_radii: The inner radius must be smaller than the outer radius.
verify.electric_pattern_reason: The electrode, thermal or material pattern differs from the analytic setup. Check mesh convergence for arbitrary shapes.
result.air_breakdown: Max field in air is {e:.3g} kV/mm, above the 3 kV/mm breakdown rule of thumb. The threshold depends on pressure and geometry; discharge is not simulated.
check.no_voltage: At least one fixed-potential face is required. Set a ground or a voltage.
err.group_members: Group members must be faces in this case.
gui.none: No GUI selection is available. Open a case and select faces in Studio.
gui.expired: The GUI selection is over 30 minutes old. Select faces again in Studio.
check.uniform_temperature: There is no heat input, so the whole part will reach ambient temperature. Apply heat flux to a heated face or specify faces at different temperatures.
err.bearing_axis: Face {face} needs cylinder axis data. Select a cylindrical face or re-import the geometry.
err.bearing_direction: Bearing force on {face} must be perpendicular to the cylinder axis.
check.bearing_axis: Bearing loads require a cylindrical face with axis data. Re-import the geometry.
check.free_free: Free-free analysis: the six rigid-body modes are excluded.
check.modal_loads_ignored: Modal analysis ignores loads and uses the supports only.
check.no_expansion: No thermal expansion: all expansion coefficients are zero.
verify.structural_pattern_reason: The conditions differ from this analytic reference. Check mesh convergence.
result.free_free: Only elastic modes are shown; the six rigid-body modes are excluded.
export.title: Analysis report
export.ran: ran: the solver ran and produced results.
export.converged: converged: residuals or force/heat balance meet the limits.
export.verified: verified: the analytic reference or GCI is within tolerance. This does not establish design safety.
